document:
From: Elena Ruiz <elena.ruiz@example.invalid>
Date: Tue, 10 Feb 2026 09:14:00 +0000
Subject: RM-201 CO2 loop - setpoint wording

Team,

I am translating the owner's note into the BMS sequence. The note says "do not exceed 1000 ppm." Can someone confirm whether that is 1000 ppm total or 1000 ppm above outdoor? I have seen both conventions. For quick sizing I assumed outside is 300 ppm.

- Elena

-----Original Message-----
From: Ravi Menon <ravi.menon@example.invalid>
Date: Tue, 10 Feb 2026 11:02:00 +0000
Subject: RE: RM-201 CO2 loop - setpoint wording

My first read was 1000 ppm above ambient (so around 1300 ppm total), but the demo screenshot has CO2Set=1 and gainSensor=1/1.519E-3, which looks like a hard 1000 ppm absolute target. We should not freeze this until design review.

Also note the Modelica freshAir source wants negative m_flow for flow into the zone. Please do not turn that into a negative physical ventilation requirement.

- Ravi

-----Original Message-----
From: Mei Ortega <mei.ortega@example.invalid>
Date: Sat, 14 Feb 2026 16:35:00 +0000
Subject: RE: RM-201 CO2 loop - DR-IAQ-05 decision

DR-IAQ-05 closed this today: owner intent is 1000 ppm ABSOLUTE room concentration. The 1300 ppm interpretation is rejected for this benchmark. Outdoor model remains 300 ppm.

Please also keep the people source trick explicit in the model notes. C=100 kg/kg is not a physical room concentration; it is only there so the carrier mass flow is 1/100 of the actual CO2 emission.

- Mei

-----Original Message-----
From: Elena Ruiz <elena.ruiz@example.invalid>
Date: Sun, 1 Mar 2026 10:08:00 +0000
Subject: RM-201 reference tuning after OCC-SCH-04 Rev C

Peak occupancy is now 15 from 13:00-15:00. CR-IAQ-007 approved Kp=6.0, bias=3.5 ACH, min=0.2, max=6.0, integral disabled for the released reference run. The old model file still has Kp=4 and peak 12.

I generated a clean run using the new values.

- Elena
